summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 56,150 shares at $17.82 per share (120% of prior closing) with 100% warrant coverage, raising $1M in gross proceeds. The SPA is a capital-raising agreement, not a transformative special situation. Proceeds fund the exercise of warrants for Hightide Energy shares. No board recommendation or advisor named. No structural changes to the company. Routine financing filing. The filing lacks elements of an acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation category.
